records.source_title: About us - Krones
records.excerpt: The company is headquartered in Neutraubling, Germany, and employs over 21,000 people worldwide. Consolidated sales in 2025 totalled 5.663 billion euros. Around 90 per cent of Krones’ products are sold abroad.
records.population: Krones Group
records.does_not_establish: Headcount and sales say nothing about how much revenue, if any, comes from small producers or individuals.

records.source_title: About us - Krones
records.excerpt: It’s not only millions of beverage bottles and cans that are handled on Krones lines every day, the company’s solutions are also used in the food and stimulants industries, plus the chemical, cosmetics and pharmaceutical sectors.
records.population: Krones Group customers by industry
records.does_not_establish: It names industries served but gives no split of revenue by industry or by customer size.

records.source_title: Strategy and management system - Krones Group Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: Looking after the delivery of digital and other services is the job of our approximately 3,000 local service technicians in over 70 countries around the world. It is they who respond quickly and directly to customer needs – a key factor in long-term customer satisfaction.
records.population: Krones service organisation and its industrial customers
records.does_not_establish: It does not show whether this field-service model could economically serve very small or private buyers.

records.source_title: Strategy and management system - Krones Group Annual Report 2025
records.excerpt: With the aid of our innovative, value-added solutions, our dense global service network and reliable completion of projects for our international customers, we are able to obtain adjusted prices despite the cost trend. Despite the ongoing intense competition for orders, we are sticking to our disciplined price strategy.
records.population: Krones Group pricing towards its customers
records.does_not_establish: It does not state margins or show how pricing would work for low-cost small or consumer equipment.

records.source_title: The Krones.shop - Krones
records.excerpt: More than 29,000 customer users and a large number of service specialists are currently registered. Krones.shop is already available in over 186 countries and in ten languages.
records.population: Registered users of Krones' online spare-parts platform
records.does_not_establish: It does not show that the shop sells to anyone other than operators of Krones machines, or what share of revenue it carries.

records.source_title: Krones to reorganise its Compact Class business (press release)
records.excerpt: In light of the current transformation in the beverage and liquid-food industry as well as rising demands for sustainable, competitive and efficient products, Krones is restructuring its profitable and growing Compact Class line of business, which delivers machines and lines for the small and medium output range.
records.population: Krones' Compact Class business (Kosme, Gernep)
records.does_not_establish: It gives no revenue figure for the Compact Class and does not say it reaches individual or hobby buyers.

records.source_title: Steinecker MicroCube brewing system for small batches - Steinecker
records.excerpt: Craft brewers need to rely on compact plants that prove their worth even when the available space is tight. Steinecker MicroCube is a brewery concept for cold wort volumes of 5, 10 or 17 hectolitres per brew.
records.population: Craft brewers buying small brewhouses from Krones' Steinecker brand
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many MicroCubes were sold, at what price, or that anything smaller than 5 hl per brew is offered.

records.source_title: Compact glass filler for the low output range Craftmate G - Krones
records.excerpt: The Craftmate C has been on the market since 2015 – inspiring small and medium-sized breweries and craft breweries all around the world ever since. Thanks to the major success of the compact can filler, Krones has now also developed a dedicated filler for the low output range for glass applications: the Craftmate G.
records.population: Small, medium-sized and craft breweries buying Krones fillers
records.does_not_establish: The claimed 'major success' is not quantified with unit sales or revenue.

records.source_title: Preview of the BrauBeviale 2016 trade fair: A brewery off the peg (press release)
records.excerpt: Krones AG traditionally uses the BrauBeviale specifically to unveil new equipment for small and mid-tier breweries. In recent years, the number of craft breweries has risen spectacularly worldwide. So Krones’ exhibits are designed to meet the needs of this sector as well.
records.population: Small, mid-tier and craft breweries
records.does_not_establish: It is a 2016 statement of intent and does not show current demand or Krones' sales to craft breweries.

records.source_title: New canning line for beer bottling centre to fill smaller batches (press release)
records.excerpt: “It’s true that Krones is well-known for its high-speed kit. So we’re all the more pleased they offer top-quality equipment for the lower output range as well.”
records.population: Rittmayer Hallerndorf brewery, a family brewery and contract filler for small breweries
records.does_not_establish: One customer quote chosen by Krones for its own press release cannot show how small producers in general see Krones.

records.source_title: Mission is flexibility for filler technology - Beverage Industry
records.excerpt: The company counts many large brewers as customers and is adapting its technology to accommodate smaller brewers, Delgado says. For craft brewers, Krones offers smaller scale fillers that can run at speeds below 250 bottles per minute.
records.population: Krones Inc. and its brewery customers
records.does_not_establish: It reports a Krones manager's 2010 statement, not independent evidence of how many small brewers bought Krones equipment.

records.source_title: Annual Craft Brewing Industry Production Report - Brewers Association
records.excerpt: 2024 was the first year since 2005 that the number of breweries that closed outpaced brewery openings nationwide. Yet, the total number of breweries in the U.S. increased to 9,922, up from 9,838 in 2023. Over the year, 430 new breweries opened while 529 closed.
records.population: U.S. breweries, craft and total
records.does_not_establish: It does not show how many of these breweries buy new equipment or what they spend on it.

records.source_title: 1.1 Million Americans Homebrew Their Own Beer - American Homebrewers Association
records.excerpt: According to newly released demographics data from the American Homebrewers Association (AHA)—the leading organization dedicated to advancing and educating people on the hobby of homebrewing—there are currently 1.1 million people in the United States who homebrew their own beer, and 40% of them started the hobby within the last four years.
records.population: U.S. homebrewers
records.does_not_establish: The 2017 count from a homebrewing advocacy body does not show current numbers or what homebrewers would pay for equipment.

records.source_title: Zahl der Brauereien in Deutschland erneut gesunken - Deutscher Brauer-Bund (press release)
records.excerpt: Nach Angaben des Statistischen Bundesamtes gab es 2024 bundesweit noch 1.459 Brauereien. Allein vergangenes Jahr mussten 52 Betriebe schließen.
records.population: German breweries
records.does_not_establish: It does not split closures by brewery size or show the equipment spending of the remaining breweries.

records.source_title: Zahl der Brauereien in Deutschland erneut gesunken - Deutscher Brauer-Bund (press release)
records.excerpt: Bis zum Beginn der Corona-Pandemie war die Zahl der Brauereien in Deutschland kontinuierlich gestiegen, insgesamt um mehr als 250 Betriebe seit 1994. Hauptgründe für den Anstieg im vergangenen Jahrzehnt waren vor allem die Craftbier-Bewegung und die dadurch ausgelöste Gründerwelle gewesen.
records.population: German breweries, including craft start-ups
records.does_not_establish: It describes past growth and does not show that the craft founding wave continues.

records.source_title: § 41 BierStV - Herstellung durch Haus- und Hobbybrauer
records.excerpt: Bier, das von Haus- und Hobbybrauern in ihren Haushalten ausschließlich zum eigenen Verbrauch hergestellt und nicht verkauft wird, ist von der Steuer bis zu einer Menge von 5 hl je Kalenderjahr befreit.
records.population: Home and hobby brewers
records.does_not_establish: The tax exemption sets a legal volume ceiling but says nothing about how many hobby brewers exist or what they buy.

records.source_title: Compact can filler for the low-capacity range - KHS Group
records.excerpt: The filler, valve manifold, seamer, control cabinet and paneling form a closed unit. The can filler Innofill Can C fills between 10,000 and 60,000 cans per hour and is thus especially suitable for craft brewers.
records.population: KHS, a Krones competitor, and its craft-brewer customers
records.does_not_establish: A competitor's product page does not show how well that craft product sells.

records.source_title: GEA CRAFT-STAR Brewhouse - GEA
records.excerpt: Designed for small to mid-sized craft breweries, the CRAFT-STAR® brewhouse line is available in two sizes, handling batches of either 20hl or 40hl of hot wort. Pre-assembled, wired and tested in Germany, CRAFT-STAR® is a compact system with integrated control cabinet and base frame that doubles up as a practical operator platform.
records.population: GEA, a Krones competitor in process technology, and small craft breweries
records.does_not_establish: It shows GEA's smallest brewhouse is still a professional 20 hl system, not whether GEA sells to hobby brewers or how the line performs.

records.source_title: Home brewing equipment made of stainless steel - Speidel's Braumeister
records.excerpt: It is the ideal brewing device for switching from hobby to commercial brewing, for example as an introduction for caterers who want to offer their own beer to their guests.
records.population: Speidel, a German stainless-steel tank maker selling Braumeister home and small brewing systems
records.does_not_establish: The manufacturer's own claim does not show sales volumes or profitability of its home-brewing line.

records.source_title: LG brews a pricey pint without leaving home - Korea JoongAng Daily
records.excerpt: Each set of capsules - different capsules contain different ingredients - can make 5 liters, or about 10.5 pints, of beer after roughly two weeks of brewing. Beer can be stored inside the machine for about 10 days without losing its fizz. It will cost 3.99 million won ($3,386).
records.population: LG Electronics' capsule home beer brewer and its buyers
records.does_not_establish: A launch report does not show how many units sold or whether the product stayed on the market.

records.source_title: Rest in Peace, PicoBrew - The Spoon
records.excerpt: PicoBrew, the homebrewing appliance startup based in Seattle, is effectively shutting down the Spoon has learned today. Back in February, the Spoon broke the story about PicoBrew entering the Washington State bankruptcy process in the form of court-managed receivership.
records.population: PicoBrew, a consumer home-brewing appliance maker
records.does_not_establish: One start-up's failure does not prove that a well-funded industrial maker would fail in the same segment.

records.source_title: Home Beer Brewing Machine Market Size, Forecasts Report 2026-2035 - Global Market Insights
records.excerpt: The home beer brewing machine market size was estimated at USD 213.4 million in 2025 and is expected to reach USD 237.9 million in 2026.
records.population: Home beer brewing machine market
records.does_not_establish: A vendor's public market-size estimate is unverified, and other research firms publish very different figures.
